function: CNN predicts the RIS phase shifts that maximize achievable rate, replacing the PSO-based phase design in RIS-aided THz hybrid beamforming (p. 14).
system: THz massive MIMO hybrid beamforming with passive reflecting RIS; CNN scenario: 16 Tx and 16 Rx antennas, 64 RIS elements, 100 GHz (p. 2, 11, 14).
method: Supervised CNN: two residual-block branches for H_Tx-RIS and H_RIS-Rx, dense layers output RIS phase angles; described as trained via PSO (p. 3, 14).
data_channel: Own simulated 3D geometry-based Saleh-Valenzuela THz channels (Scenario 3); dataset of simulated RIS configurations, channel responses and achievable rates; dataset size not stated (p. 5, 14).
test_conditions: Training, validation and test sets split from the same Scenario 3 dataset; no other scenario, band, or array size tested for the CNN (p. 14).
baselines: PSO (non-learned optimization) and random phase settings for the CNN; no learned baseline. Main design also compared with fully digital BF with RIS [24] (p. 11, 14).
metrics: Achievable rate (bps/Hz) for training, validation, and test sets; relative processing time against PSO (p. 14).
complexity: CNN processing time about 95% below PSO (p. 14); PSO runtime 5.66 min for 20 iterations, 72.17 min for 90 (p. 13); no CNN parameter or FLOP count.
q1_support: p. 5: "statistical channel model known as the Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) channel model [29]" - custom geometry-based simulator; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 14: "training, validation, and test sets to ensure comprehensive" - split of the same Scenario 3 dataset; no other scenario, band, or array size is tested for the CNN.
q3_support: p. 14: "is evaluated against the PSO method and random phase" settings - both non-learned; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared for the phase design.
q4_support: p. 14: "95% reduction in processing time compared to the" PSO-based solution; p. 13: "computation time required was approximately 5.66 minutes" for PSO; no CNN FLOPs or parameters.
q5_support: p. 14: "we generate a dataset through simulations of various RIS" configurations - self-generated; no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset in the paper.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Borderline on no_learning: the main design is classical (angular RF stage, SVD and water-filling, PSO for RIS phases); included because a supervised CNN performs the RIS phase design (abstract p. 1, Section IV-C p. 14). q4 rests on a relative runtime (95% below PSO) plus PSO runtimes in minutes.
